item.title: Fake AI images of protester go viral after woman punched at Trump's Ohio rally
item.description: A protester who heckled Donald Trump at his midterm rally in Youngstown, Ohio, was physically assaulted and removed from the event, but fake AI-generated photos recreating the incident are going viral online.
